correctness.rationale: The subset model and section formula can be verified directly. Over the algebraic closure choose an unramified infinity and write y²=f(x) of degree 2g+2. The difference of two eligible subset classes is the even symmetric difference R, minus |R|H/2. If principal, a defining function has hyperelliptic-involution-invariant divisor, hence is an eigenfunction A(x) or yB(x). Its branch valuations are respectively all even or all odd, forcing R empty or full. Counting the resulting 2^(2g) classes proves exhaustiveness. For s=|S|≤g+1 and m=(g-1-s)/2, split sections of D_S into invariant and anti-invariant parts. The invariant part consists of polynomials of degree at most m; the anti-invariant part has the form y b(x)/∏_{P∈S}(x-x(P)), whose pole order at infinity for nonzero polynomial b is at least g+1-s>m. Thus h⁰=(g+1-s)/2, including zero at s=g+1. The classes and parities are equivariant because H is the hyperelliptic fiber class. For n odd, set d=gcd(8r,n) and e=8r/d; d is odd and 8 divides e. Type (8r,2) has only alternating complement-swappers among fixed classes, giving 2^d central-size even classes. Type (8r,1,1) has only literal fixed subsets as representatives of fixed classes; the shorter representative selects one fixed point and j≤(d-1)/2 long cycles, giving 2^d classes with even h⁰=e(d-2j)/4. At even powers the branch permutations are conjugate. Möbius inversion in each parity gives the same orbit multiset. Squarefree monic degree 8r+2 models using an irreducible degree-8r factor and either an irreducible quadratic or two distinct linear factors exist over every odd F_q; the two branch rational-point counts are 0 and 2. Replay: frozen RESULT.md §§1–4 with the divisor argument above. The supporting script and CSV were inspected, not executed; the finite spectra are not used for the universal conclusion.

value.rationale: This is a systematic arithmetic reconstruction obstruction: even the joint counts on the two spin parities over every extension lose branch-splitting information, over every odd base field and at arbitrarily large genus. The all-genus mechanism distinguishes genuinely different ways of fixing a spin class rather than recomputing a fixed-genus table. No assertion is needed about curve zeta functions, Jacobians, or incidence-preserving spin identifications.
